problem.title: Why do so many people run into problems with their work?
problem.intro: Repeated delays, quotes that spiral, botched work or an unreachable tradesperson: most bad experiences follow the same patterns. Understanding where things go wrong is already the first step to protecting yourself.
problem.body:
• A tradesperson who disappears after a deposit.
  • A quote that doubles with no clear explanation.
  • Botched work that has to be redone.
  • Deadlines that aren't met.
  • Clients left alone to deal with complicated situations.

But not every setback is necessarily a scam.

An honest tradesperson can also run into a serious problem:

  • a financial difficulty,
  • or an unexpected issue on site that's more complex than planned.

A client can also describe their need poorly at the start.

And sometimes it's simply poor communication between the parties that complicates the situation.

The real problem today isn't that abuse exists.

The real problem is that there is usually no system genuinely designed to protect the individual when things get complicated.

In a traditional setup, once the money has been paid directly to the company, getting the funds back can become extremely difficult.

With Artisan Compétent, the money is overseen via Stripe in an escrow account until the project is validated.

The funds are not sent directly to the tradesperson.

Nor do they pass through Artisan Compétent's bank account.

Even the platform's director cannot freely divert the funds.

The system is designed precisely to prevent that.

In concrete terms:

  • either the work is finished and validated, and the funds are released;
  • or a problem arises, and the funds stay held while the situation is analysed.

All project tracking is centralised: photos, messages, quotes, proof.

Every step is time-stamped and archived to allow clear and transparent tracking.

framework.title: Artisan Compétent: a framework designed to keep situations from escalating
framework.intro: Artisan Compétent doesn't just connect you with a tradesperson: the platform oversees every project, from the quote to final validation. Discover how this framework concretely protects your money and your work.
framework.accordionTitle: Discover the framework that oversees your project
framework.body:
Artisan Compétent is not a simple directory.

The platform was designed to:

  • track every stage of the project,
  • and make it easier to resolve disputes when they arise.

The challenge isn't only to find a tradesperson.

The goal is to create a framework that is more reassuring, more transparent and safer for everyone.

Because today, finding a tradesperson is no longer enough.

You also need to know who truly protects your money if things go wrong.

cmod.title: CMOD: a remote construction advisor for your project
cmod.lead: Not a building professional yourself, and you'd like extra reassurance during your project?
cmod.fullDescription:
The CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) is an experienced construction professional who supports you remotely by video call throughout your project.

Their role isn't to replace the tradesperson or to visit the site, but to give you an independent professional perspective to help you better understand the various stages of the project, the technical discussions and the important decisions.

At Artisan Compétent, the professionals on the platform are already verified and the work is overseen through our digital tracking system, photo proof, traceability and fund protection.

The CMOD is therefore an optional add-on for clients who want even more reassuring support, particularly for longer or more technical projects.

In the event of a disagreement or dispute with a tradesperson, and when no amicable solution could be found at first, a CMOD call can also be offered to help the parties better understand the situation and encourage a constructive resolution.

protection.title: The Artisan Compétent framework in detail
protection.lead: Understand exactly how our protection system works.

escrow.title: Fund escrow: your protection against nasty surprises
escrow.body:
On many platforms, the client pays a deposit or the full amount directly to the tradesperson before the work is even finished.

At Artisan Compétent, it works in a completely different way.

When you accept a quote and make your payment via the platform, the funds are immediately secured in an escrow account managed by Stripe, a certified, internationally recognised payment provider.

In concrete terms, this means the money is neither in the tradesperson's account nor in Artisan Compétent's bank account.

Even Artisan Compétent's director cannot freely access, transfer or divert the funds.

The amounts stay held within Stripe's secure protocol until the project is validated or any dispute is resolved.

This system protects, at the same time:

  • the client,
  • the tradesperson,
  • and the funds tied to the work.

How does it work in practice?

You accept the quote and make the payment directly via the platform.

The funds are then placed in secure escrow.

Throughout the project, you can follow progress from your digital dashboard:

  • photos,
  • messages,
  • documents related to the project.

The professional can add tracking items, but you can also:

  • add your own observations,
  • report a problem if necessary.

Each item is time-stamped and archived to ensure complete traceability of the project.

Nothing can be deleted from the tracking once it has been recorded.

validation.title: Work validation and release of funds
validation.body:
Once the project is finished, the professional sends you a digital completion report.

You then have up to 48 hours to:

  • validate the report,
  • or request a correction if necessary.

During this period, the funds stay secured and are not paid to the professional.

If no problem is reported within the set period, the funds are released automatically in line with the conditions set out in the Terms of Use, and the report is deemed validated without reservation.

In the event of a dispute, the funds stay held while Artisan Compétent analyses the records in the digital tracking, to support arbitration based on concrete evidence.

klarna.title: Payment in instalments via Klarna
klarna.body:
For some quotes, payment in instalments can be offered via Klarna.

This option is not imposed by Artisan Compétent and depends entirely on the professional's choice.

Using Klarna does indeed involve additional fees, which are borne by the tradesperson.

The professional therefore remains free:

  • to offer payment in instalments,
  • or to decline this payment facility depending on their organisation and cash flow.

Artisan Compétent simply makes this technical feature available to tradespeople who wish to enable it.

By default, Artisan Compétent observes that most eligible clients generally have a financing limit of up to €1,500 via Klarna.

However, some clients may qualify for a higher limit depending on their profile and the conditions set directly by Klarna.

It is therefore up to the client to check directly with Klarna the exact amount they qualify for as well as the financing terms available.

The funds are never released before final validation of the project handover report, or resolution of the case in the event of a dispute.

malfacon.title: Notice a problem or a defect? Here's the right approach.
malfacon.body:
1. Talk to the tradesperson

The vast majority of situations are resolved simply through dialogue.

The tradespeople on Artisan Compétent are verified, serious professionals.

As on any project, a finish, an adjustment or a detail may sometimes need correcting after the work.

Before reporting anything, take the time to talk calmly with the professional in order to look for an amicable solution.

2. Report the problem from your client area

If, despite these discussions, no agreement is reached, you can report the problem directly from your dashboard.

From that point, the Artisan Compétent team can access all the digital tracking already present on the platform:

  • photos,
  • messages in the internal chat,
  • items added by the client and the professional.

The advantage of this approach is that it spares the parties from having to start over or resend everything.

As the project is already documented directly within the platform, the team can analyse the situation from the items already recorded and time-stamped.

Only in certain cases will additional information or items be requested, if this is needed to deepen the analysis.

Throughout this phase, the funds stay held in secure escrow.

3. Analysis of the situation and overseen mediation

In the event of a dispute, Artisan Compétent analyses the records in the digital tracking in order to encourage a balanced resolution based on concrete evidence.

It is important to point out that Artisan Compétent does not impose a price grid on the professionals on the platform.

Prices remain free.

Tradespeople set their own rates and quotes according to their experience, their structure, their geographic area and the nature of the work carried out.

The platform simply provides recommendations and best practices to encourage consistent and transparent practices.

Cases of clear abuse mainly concern certain particularly sensitive emergency call-outs, especially at night or in immediate repair situations.

In the rare cases where clearly excessive and entirely disproportionate overcharging is found compared with the practices usually observed for this type of call-out, Artisan Compétent may launch an enhanced mediation procedure in accordance with the Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

Before any measure is taken, an attempt at an amicable resolution is always favoured with the professional concerned.

If no reasonable agreement is found despite the discussions and the analysis of the evidence, Artisan Compétent may:

  • temporarily suspend the professional's account,
  • or even permanently remove their access to the platform in the event of a serious breach.

In this context, a processing fee of up to a set amount may be applied in accordance with the Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

This fee is not kept by Artisan Compétent and is paid back to the client from the escrowed portion, in order to partly compensate for the harm suffered.

This type of situation nevertheless remains exceptional, as the vast majority of tradespeople on the platform are serious, good-faith professionals.

signed.title: And what if you've already signed the report?
signed.body:
Don't panic.

The tradespeople on Artisan Compétent remain bound by their professional obligations and by the legal warranties that apply to the work carried out.

Like any serious professional, they will step in if a legitimate correction is needed after the project has been handed over.

Depending on the nature of the work, various legal warranties then continue to apply:

  • the defects (snagging) warranty,
  • the two-year warranty when the work concerned requires it,
  • the ten-year warranty when the work concerned requires it.

Take the time to check. Your safety also depends on those checks.

q1.question: How much does it cost for an individual?
q1.summary: Matchmaking is free for individuals. You only pay the amount of the accepted quote, through secure escrowed payment on the platform. Artisan Compétent earns its income through a commission on the professional's pre-tax quote.
q1.body:
Matchmaking is free for individuals.

You only pay the amount of the accepted quote, through the secure escrowed payment system built into the platform.

Artisan Compétent earns its income through a commission taken from the professional's pre-tax quote.

q2.question: What is the CMOD?
q2.summary: The CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) is a construction professional who supports the client remotely by video call during the project. They help with understanding technical situations and make dialogue between the parties easier. Monitoring packages are available depending on the length of the project, and a CMOD call can also be offered in the event of a dispute.
q2.body:
The CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) is an experienced construction professional who can support the client remotely during the project.

Their role is to:

  • help with better understanding certain technical situations,
  • and make dialogue between the parties easier when needed.

The support is provided remotely by video call, without any site visit.

Monitoring packages are available depending on the length of the project.

In the event of a dispute, and after an attempt at an amicable agreement, a CMOD call can also be offered to help find a solution.

q3.question: Can I pay in instalments?
q3.summary: Yes, payment in instalments via Klarna can be offered directly on the platform. This option depends on the professional accepting it and on your Klarna eligibility. The financing is free of charge for the client when Klarna approves it, under the conditions offered at the time of payment.
q3.body:
Yes, a payment-in-instalments option via Klarna can be offered directly on the platform.

This option is optional and depends on:

  • the professional accepting it,
  • and your eligibility, which is determined directly by Klarna.

The financing is free of charge for the client when it is approved by Klarna, under the conditions offered at the time of payment.

Each client should check directly with Klarna the amounts and financing terms they qualify for.

q4.question: Does Artisan Compétent operate everywhere in France?
q4.summary: Artisan Compétent is in a gradual rollout across mainland France, Corsica and the overseas territories. The platform already covers several cities and keeps expanding. If your area isn't served yet, you can encourage local tradespeople to join the platform, or become an affiliate to earn income on signed quotes.
q4.body:
The platform is in a gradual rollout phase.

Artisan Compétent already covers several French cities and keeps developing throughout mainland France, Corsica and the overseas territories.

The long-term goal is to offer a national network able to cover both large cities and more rural areas.

If your area isn't covered yet, it simply means the platform is still being developed in your zone.

You can also encourage serious tradespeople in your region to join the platform: the more there are, the faster and more effective the local coverage will be.

And if you'd like to take part in the development of Artisan Compétent, you can also join our affiliate programme.

Affiliates can recommend the platform to both clients and tradespeople and earn income on quotes signed through their recommendations.

Depending on the case and the campaigns running, this income can be paid for several months and up to a year for some profiles brought to the platform.

This makes it possible to:

  • grow a community of trust in the construction industry,
  • and let affiliates generate extra income by recommending a useful and secure solution.

q5.question: What should I do if I disagree with the quote or the work delivered?
q5.summary: First, favour talking it through with the tradesperson: most situations are settled amicably. For abusive quotes in emergencies or at night, you can report it from your dashboard within 48h. During the analysis, the funds stay in escrow and amicable mediation is favoured before any measure is taken.
q5.body:
The first thing to do is talk it through directly with the tradesperson.

The vast majority of situations are settled amicably. A serious tradesperson will agree to discuss it, explain a technical point, or come back to fix a finish if needed.

It is strongly advised to take the time for that discussion before reporting anything.

Regarding quotes considered abusive, Artisan Compétent only steps in in certain very specific cases of immediate or night-time emergencies, when the client doesn't really have time to compare prices or step back before accepting.

If clearly excessive abuse is found on this type of call-out, a report can be made from the client dashboard within 48 hours after the end of the work.

During this period:

  • the funds stay held in escrow,
  • the case can be analysed,
  • and amicable mediation is favoured.

If clear abuse is confirmed and the professional persistently refuses to find an amicable solution, Artisan Compétent may apply the measures set out in its Terms of Use and Terms of Sale, which can go as far as:

  • suspending or removing the professional's account,
  • applying a suspension processing fee of up to a set amount.

This fee can be taken directly from the escrowed amount when the abuse is clearly established, and is paid back to the client concerned in line with the way the platform works.

This mechanism remains exceptional and mainly concerns the rare situations of very significant abuse on emergency call-outs.

For standard projects and non-urgent quotes, prices remain free.

The client generally has the time needed to compare several quotes, ask their questions and accept or decline the proposal before signing.

q6.question: What happens if I don't validate the completion report within 48h?
q6.summary: After the project completion report is sent, you have 48 hours to validate it, contest it or report a problem. A reminder email is sent 8 hours before the deadline. If you take no action within the 48h, the report is validated automatically and the funds are released to the professional.
q6.body:
Once the project completion report is sent by the professional, the funds stay held in escrow for a period of up to 48 hours.

This period allows the client:

  • to check the work carried out,
  • or to request a correction if necessary.

Eight hours before the deadline, an automatic reminder email is sent to the client to remind them that they must either validate the report or report any problem before the deadline expires.

If no reservation, challenge or report is made within the 48 hours, the report is automatically deemed validated in accordance with the platform's Terms of Use and Terms of Sale.

The escrowed funds are then released automatically to the professional.

Once the report is validated, the construction industry's legal warranties of course remain applicable depending on the nature of the work carried out:

  • the defects (snagging) warranty,
  • the two-year warranty,
  • or the ten-year warranty when it is required.

q7.question: What happens if the work is done badly?
q7.summary: First, talk to the tradesperson: most defects are settled quickly through dialogue. If the problem persists, don't validate the report and report it from your dashboard within 48h; the funds stay in escrow. A discussion with a CMOD can be arranged, and the legal warranties (defects, two-year, ten-year) then apply depending on the work.
q7.body:
The first step is always to discuss it directly with the tradesperson.

Most defects or finishing problems are settled quickly when they're reported properly.

If the problem persists:

  • do not validate the project completion report,
  • report the situation from your dashboard within 48h,
  • and explain precisely the problem encountered.

During this period, the funds stay held in escrow.

The Artisan Compétent team can then analyse the situation from the digital tracking already present on the platform:

  • photos,
  • messages,
  • and items submitted during the work.

If necessary, a discussion with a CMOD (Digital Client Project Advisor) can also be arranged to help better understand the situation and encourage an amicable resolution.

If the report has already been signed, the serious tradespeople on the platform are still required to step in to correct any defect that falls under their responsibility.

And in any case, the legal warranties then continue to apply depending on the work carried out:

  • the defects (snagging) warranty,
  • the two-year warranty,
  • or the ten-year warranty.

q8.question: How can I avoid scams when looking for a tradesperson?
q8.summary: The best way to avoid scams is to never send money directly to a tradesperson without oversight or tracking. On Artisan Compétent, professionals are verified, communication is centralised, the work is tracked step by step and the funds stay in escrow via Stripe until validation. The system protects you even if the professional runs into financial difficulty or closes their business.
q8.body:
The best way to avoid scams is to never send money directly to a tradesperson without oversight or tracking.

With Artisan Compétent:

  • professionals are verified before joining,
  • communication is centralised,
  • the work is tracked step by step,
  • and the funds stay secured in escrow until the project is validated.

The system was designed to limit:

  • abandoned projects,
  • overcharged call-outs,
  • and situations where a tradesperson disappears after payment.

Even in the event of a life accident, financial difficulty or closure of the professional's business, the funds escrowed via Stripe stay protected within the secure payment protocol as long as they have not been released.

q9.question: How much does a plumber, an electrician or a locksmith cost on Artisan Compétent?
q9.summary: Prices depend on the trade, the type of call-out, the materials, the geographic area and the time of the service. Each tradesperson sets their own rates freely and presents their quote directly via the platform. To compare several proposals and learn the usual price ranges for your need, see the dedicated page for each trade.
q9.body:
On Artisan Compétent, prices are not set by the platform. Each tradesperson sets their own rates freely and presents their quote directly via their professional area.

Several factors influence the price of a call-out:

  • the trade involved (plumber, electrician, locksmith, heating engineer, drain unblocker, etc.),
  • the nature of the work (repair, installation, renovation),
  • the materials needed,
  • the geographic area of the call-out,
  • whether or not the request is urgent,
  • and the time of the call-out (day, night, weekend, public holidays).

To get an idea of the orders of magnitude and the usual price ranges for your need, see the dedicated page for each trade on the platform.

Our advice: always ask for several quotes before signing, compare the detailed services and don't hesitate to ask the tradesperson for clarification via Artisan Compétent's secure internal chat.

q10.question: What is the difference between Artisan Compétent and a standard matchmaking platform?
q10.summary: Unlike standard platforms that only do matchmaking, Artisan Compétent oversees the whole service: tradespeople verified before joining, payment escrowed via Stripe until the project is validated, time-stamped digital tracking, mediation available in the event of a dispute. The money never passes directly to the tradesperson or to Artisan Compétent.
q10.body:
Most construction platforms only connect a client with a tradesperson. Once the connection is made, the client is left alone with the professional to handle payment, project tracking and any disputes.

Artisan Compétent works differently:

  • tradespeople are verified before joining (business registration, insurance, certifications),
  • communication goes through the secure internal chat,
  • payment is escrowed via Stripe until the project is validated,
  • every step is time-stamped and archived in the digital tracking,
  • mediation is available in the event of a dispute, based on the recorded evidence.

The money never passes directly to the tradesperson, nor even into Artisan Compétent's bank account. The funds stay within Stripe's secure protocol until they are released to the professional or returned to the client depending on the situation.

This complete framework aims to protect both honest clients and serious tradespeople, and to restore trust in the construction sector.

q11.question: How can I find a good plumber, electrician or locksmith near me?
q11.summary: On Artisan Compétent, enter your address, select the trade you're looking for and set a call-out radius. The platform shows the verified tradespeople available in your area, with their certifications, insurance and reviews. You choose who to contact, compare quotes, and payment stays overseen until the work is validated.
q11.body:
Finding a good tradesperson is, above all, finding a professional who is verified, serious and suited to your specific need.

On Artisan Compétent, the search takes just a few steps:

  • enter your address from the homepage or your dashboard,
  • select the trade you're looking for (plumber, electrician, locksmith, heating engineer, etc.),
  • set the search radius around your area,
  • review the list of professionals matching your criteria.

For each tradesperson shown, you can access:

  • the checks carried out (business registration, insurance, certifications),
  • the reviews left by previous clients who completed a project via the platform,
  • and the option to start a conversation via the secure internal chat.

You choose for yourself which professionals to contact, you compare the quotes received, and you sign with full knowledge of the facts. Payment stays overseen until validation of the project completion report.

q12.question: How does Klarna instalment payment work on Artisan Compétent?
q12.summary: Klarna lets you pay in instalments on Artisan Compétent. The option is only offered if the professional accepts it (the Klarna fees are borne by them) and if you are eligible under Klarna's conditions. The observed limit is generally €1,500, sometimes higher depending on your profile. The eligibility check is carried out at the time of payment.
q12.body:
Artisan Compétent makes the Klarna payment solution available so that clients can spread the payment of a quote over several instalments.

This option works under three conditions:

  • the professional's acceptance, since the Klarna fees are borne entirely by the tradesperson who enables this option,
  • your financing eligibility, determined solely by Klarna based on your profile,
  • the conditions offered by Klarna at the time of payment.

By default, Artisan Compétent observes that most eligible clients generally have a financing limit of up to €1,500 via Klarna. Some clients may qualify for a higher limit depending on their profile and the conditions set directly by Klarna.

It is up to each client to check with Klarna:

  • the exact amount they qualify for,
  • the financing terms available,
  • and any fees or interest applicable depending on their situation.

The financing is free of charge for the client when Klarna approves the application under the conditions offered at the time of payment. The funds paid via Klarna stay overseen within Stripe escrow until final validation of the project, just like any other payment method.

q13.question: What should I do in an emergency: water leak, heating breakdown, slammed door?
q13.summary: Artisan Compétent gives you access to emergency tradespeople 24/7 for plumbing, heating, locksmithing, electricity and drain unblocking. Even in an emergency, fund escrow applies: you only release the payment once the call-out is finished, and the 48-hour rule to react still applies. See the page for each emergency trade for the details.
q13.body:
Emergencies don't wait. Water leak, heating breakdown, slammed door, power cut, blocked pipe: Artisan Compétent gives you access to emergency tradespeople available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

The 5 emergency trades covered:

  • Emergency plumber (leak, water damage),
  • Emergency heating engineer (boiler breakdown, no heating),
  • Emergency locksmith (slammed door, broken lock),
  • Emergency electrician (power cut, short circuit),
  • Emergency drain unblocker (blocked pipe, backflow).

Even in an emergency, the platform's framework applies:

  • communication goes through the platform,
  • Stripe fund escrow still applies,
  • you only release the payment once the call-out is finished,
  • you have 48 hours to react, raise a reservation or contest the report.

It is precisely in emergency situations that night-time overcharging and clearly excessive pricing abuse are most common. Artisan Compétent's arbitration system is calibrated to handle these situations as a priority.

For each emergency trade, a dedicated page details the call-outs covered, the response times and the precautions to know before accepting a quote. See the page for the relevant trade for more details.

meta.title: Artisan Compétent Partner Program | 20% Commission
meta.description: Recommend Artisan Compétent to your audience and earn 20% commission the first year. Free signup, no commitment, no upfront cost.

hero.subtitle: Recommend the platform that puts an end to construction scams. Earn 1 year of commission on every new client: 20% the first 6 months, 10% the next 6. No long-term contract, no commitment, no upfront cost.

howItWorks.title: Three steps, that's it.
howItWorks.step1Body: Free signup, no minimum audience required. You receive a unique affiliate link and a short code, both tied to your partner account. That's how your referrals are tracked.
howItWorks.step2Title: Talk about Artisan Compétent to your audience.
howItWorks.step2Body: To your family, your followers, your clients, your network. Video, post, story, word of mouth — your call. The only rule: at least one piece of content per week, so we know you're active (and so your audience keeps you in mind).
howItWorks.step3Body: When the person you referred takes action and the work is completed (handover certificate signed), your commission is validated. Quarterly bank transfer and PDF receipt available in your partner dashboard. And every month, you receive an email report with the number of referrals signed up thanks to you and the status of each.

commissions.title: It's simple. Really.
commissions.summaryClient: You refer a client: 20% the first 6 months, 10% the next 6.
commissions.summaryArtisan: You refer a professional: 5% for 6 months.
commissions.summaryBoth: You do both: you stack, up to 25%.
commissions.detailsTitle: The details if you need them
commissions.detailClient: Individual client: 20% commission on Artisan Compétent's margin during the first 6 months after the client's signup, 10% during the next 6 months. After 12 months, the commission ends.
commissions.detailArtisan: Referred professional: 5% on the margin generated by jobs signed through this professional, for 6 months after their signup on the platform.
commissions.detailCumul: Stacking: if you bring in both a client and a professional, you earn on both. The same person can therefore earn up to 25% on a single job (20% on the client side + 5% on the professional side).
commissions.condition1: Attribution cookie valid for 15 days after the first click on your link. It renews with every new click from a visitor via your link. So in practice, as long as you publish regularly, the cookie stays active.
commissions.condition2: On top of the cookie, your referral is tied to your partner account at signup. You earn commissions for the 12 months following their signup (6 months for any referred professional).
commissions.condition3: You must publish at least one piece of content per week to stay active. After 7 days without publication, you receive a warning. After 14 days, your link is deactivated. All referrals already tied to your account keep generating commissions normally.
commissions.condition4: Commissions only apply to Artisan Compétent's margin. Never on materials, never on the labor billed by the professional.
commissions.condition5: Quarterly bank transfer, starting from the handover certificate signed by the client. No payment on signed quote alone, because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job.

whyRecommend.title: You're not selling a product. You're selling protection. And you're building your brand.
whyRecommend.intro: Recommending Artisan Compétent isn't pushing yet another offer. It's telling your audience: here's how to put an end to inflated quotes, vanishing professionals, and botched jobs that you have to pay for anyway. Whether for a major renovation project or an emergency intervention of one or two days, the platform covers the full range.
whyRecommend.arg1: Escrow protection: the client's money is only released to the professional after the work is validated. That speaks to everyone.
whyRecommend.arg2: Professionals are verified (business registration, public liability insurance, ten-year warranty). No shady profiles.
whyRecommend.arg3: The CMOD service is an option to better oversee the job. For quotes between €2,000 and €5,000, a first 20-minute call is free. For quotes above €5,000, it's a 45-minute call.
whyRecommend.arg4: Signup is free for both clients and professionals. No barrier to entry.
whyRecommend.arg5: Klarna's split payment is available up to €1,500 on quotes, for both major projects and emergency interventions. Subject to the professional accepting to cover the fees (4.9% of the total quote).
whyRecommend.outro: If your audience includes homeowners, renters who want to renovate, condo owners, or simply people who are afraid of getting ripped off on a job, you have a natural audience for Artisan Compétent.

brandFomo.title: An opportunity not to miss.
brandFomo.body1: Recommending Artisan Compétent positions you as a trusted creator. Other brands see this as a signal of reliability, which can open up new partnership opportunities.
brandFomo.body2: And let's be lucid: you don't own your audience. The people who follow you also follow other creators. If you don't recommend Artisan Compétent today, someone else will tomorrow. And they'll be the ones earning the commission.
brandFomo.analogyTitle: An analogy to see the stakes
brandFomo.analogy: Imagine you own a 100,000 m² plot of land. Your neighbors each have 100 m² adjacent to yours. An oil company comes to you: there's oil under your land, we'll extract it and pay you a percentage. You refuse because you want more. The company simply goes to your neighbors, installs its rigs, and extracts the same oil. You missed the opportunity. Your audience works exactly the same way.

expectations.title: No magic, no promises. Just consistency.
expectations.exp1: At least one publication per week mentioning Artisan Compétent: video, post, story, podcast, or article.
expectations.exp2: One proof to add each week in your partner dashboard (direct link to your publication). Takes 30 seconds: copy the link to your post, paste it in the dedicated field, done.
expectations.exp3: Respect for the legal framework: no lying about what the platform is, no overselling what it does. Transparency is our hallmark, and we expect the same from our partners.
expectations.exp4: Normal use of your link: no spam, no purchase of unqualified traffic, no cookie fraud. Any manipulation triggers immediate suspension without notice.
expectations.note: We don't ask for minimum numbers, no KPI to hit. The only rule is consistency. If you publish every week, you stay in the program, whether you make 2 signups or 200.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a large audience to join the program?
faq.a1: No. The program is open to everyone, no minimum threshold. A friend who tells 5 people about Artisan Compétent can generate a commission. We prefer 100 active and consistent partners over 10 large passive audiences.
faq.q2: When do I get my commission?
faq.a2: When the job is finished. Concretely: your referral signs their quote, the work is done, they sign the handover certificate, and that's when your commission is validated. Payment is quarterly by bank transfer.
faq.q3: Why not when the quote is signed?
faq.a3: Because a quote can still be cancelled mid-job (issue, accident, disagreement), in which case the client is refunded via escrow. On a signed handover certificate, it's clean: the work is done, the money is released, your commission is due.
faq.q4: What happens if I stop publishing?
faq.a4: Don't worry. If more than 7 days go by without proof of content, you receive a warning. After 14 days, your affiliate link is deactivated. All referrals already tied to your account keep generating commissions normally. You can reactivate your link at any time by resuming activity.
faq.q5: What if the person I referred takes time to take action?
faq.a5: You have 15 days after the first click for the conversion to be attributed to your link via the cookie. This duration is intentionally short to encourage you to publish regularly. The cookie renews with every new click from a visitor via your link. Good news: your referral is also tied to your partner account at signup, so we can keep paying you for the 12 months following (6 months for any referred professional).
faq.q6: Can I combine this program with other affiliations?
faq.a6: Yes, no problem. The only case where we cut the link is if you simultaneously recommend a direct competitor of Artisan Compétent (another platform with escrow).
faq.q7: Can I refer my own clients or friends?
faq.a7: Yes, as long as the person you refer actually uses the platform for a real job. Referring close contacts without a real project is considered cookie fraud and triggers suspension.
faq.a8: You enter your IBAN in your partner dashboard. Payment is automatic by bank transfer every quarter. A PDF receipt is generated and downloadable from your dashboard.
faq.q9: What do I have to declare for taxes?
faq.a9: Commissions are income to be declared. Depending on your status, the tax regime differs. Artisan Compétent provides an annual summary of amounts paid. We recommend consulting a tax advisor if you exceed €2,000 in commissions per year.

ctaFinal.title: Ready to join the program?
ctaFinal.subtitle: Signup in 2 minutes. No commitment, no fees, no hidden conditions. You receive your affiliate link immediately.

legal.title: Legal notice and program conditions
legal.item1: The partner program is open to adult individuals and to legal entities established in France or the European Union.
legal.item2: Commissions are calculated on Artisan Compétent's net margin and paid quarterly, subject to the handover certificate being signed by the referral.
legal.item3: The cookie attribution period is 15 days, in line with CNIL recommendations. The partner account link allows compensation to extend beyond the cookie: 12 months for a referred client, 6 months for a referred professional.
legal.item4: Artisan Compétent reserves the right to suspend or terminate access to the program in case of breach of the rules of use (fraud, spam, inappropriate content, non-compliance with regulations).
legal.item5: Changes to the commission grid apply only to new signups; conversions already registered remain compensated according to the conditions in force at the time of the original click.
legal.item6: Any dispute falls under French jurisdiction.
